prompt.zh-TW: 初陽貿易的分錄都過完帳了，每個 T 字帳都有餘額。先把這些科目放進正確的要素，再想一想：哪些要素的餘額會到損益表，哪些會到資產負債表？
prompt.en: All of First Light Trading’s entries have been posted and every T-account has a balance. Sort these accounts into the right element, then think: which elements’ balances go to the income statement, and which to the balance sheet?

explanation.zh-TW: 折舊費用與所得稅費用屬於費損，營業收入屬於收益，這三個科目的餘額進損益表，結算為本期淨利。應付帳款是負債，存貨是資產，股本是股東權益，餘額列在資產負債表。本期淨利再經由未分配盈餘進入資產負債表，兩張表就是這樣接起來的。
explanation.en: Depreciation expense and income tax expense are expenses and revenue belongs to income; these three balances go to the income statement and combine into profit for the period. Trade payables are a liability, inventory an asset and share capital equity; their balances sit on the balance sheet. Profit for the period then flows into the balance sheet through unappropriated retained earnings, which is how the two statements connect.
